description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - Notify the meeting for the purpose of electing Mayor & Deputy Mayor of the Hambanthota Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the purpose of electing the Mayor and Deputy Mayor of the Hambantota Municipal Council. It is issued under the authority of election-related legislation (Elections for Local Government Bodies Act, as amended) and deals specifically with the electoral process for a local government body. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers election announcements, schedules, and related electoral matters.
